title: Closing your account
text: You can close your Zapp account from Settings, Account, Close account. Closing is permanent after a 14-day grace period, during which you can reactivate by signing in. Any active orders must be completed or cancelled before the account can be closed.
questions: How do I delete my Zapp account?
Can I cancel my account permanently?
What happens to my open orders if I close my account?
